title: Sourcing Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🪵️sourcing plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/, crate semio-s-plugin-sourcing) to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule. Pure mechanical file relocation + path/wiring string updates, no logic changes. Scope: only ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/, excluding 🧩️extensions/ (3 separate crates: beams/slabs/windows — leave entirely alone) and 🔨️modules/* (out of scope). Steps: (1) move 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path in Cargo.toml, prefix every #[path] with ../../; (2) fold any sibling 🦀️<topic>.rs files beside a 🦀️component.rs into their own component folder; (3) relocate nested 📚️examples/, 🧫️fixtures/, 🤖️generated/, 🛂️manifest.json to the owner root sibling of 📦️packages; (4) move any nested AGENTS.md/README.md to owner root byte-for-byte (flag collision if owner root AGENTS.md already exists, which it does). Verify with cargo check/clippy/test -p semio-s-plugin-sourcing matching baseline test count.
summary:
Retrofitted 🪵️sourcing (semio-s-plugin-sourcing) to Shape V2 tree purity. Pure mechanical relocation, zero logic changes.

Moves:
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/📦️lib.rs → ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs. [lib] path updated "../../📦️lib.rs" → "📦️lib.rs". All 20 leaf #[path] strings prefixed with ../../; the 9 grouping-module #[path="."] resets were kept unprefixed (empirically confirmed via cargo check that ../../ on nested resets composes cumulatively and over-corrects — applying the correction once, at each leaf, is correct and matches V1 leaf-path values exactly).
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🎛️apps/🗂️curate/🦀️config.rs → ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🎛️apps/🗂️curate/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs (byte-identical, verified via diff against git HEAD).
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🎛️apps/🗂️curate/🦀️terminology.rs → ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🪵️sourcing/🎛️apps/🗂️curate/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (byte-identical, verified via diff against git HEAD).

No buried 📚️examples/🧫️fixtures/🤖️generated/manifest.json found (📚️examples was already correctly at owner root). No nested AGENTS.md/README.md found beyond the existing owner-root AGENTS.md (no collision). 🧩️extensions/ and 🔨️modules/* untouched.

Verification: root-workspace cargo commands remain blocked by the known pre-existing 📕️norm dangling-manifest issue (unrelated, retried at end, still blocked). Used the TEMPLATE.md §3 isolated temporary [workspace] overlay in the plugin's own Cargo.toml (removed before handoff, along with the nested target/ and Cargo.lock it generated) to get real results: `cargo check` clean, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean (zero warnings on this crate; the one warning shown is in the external semio-framework-plugin dependency, not a workspace member under the overlay, pre-existing/out of scope), `cargo test` 65 passed / 0 failed, `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` clean. Test-count floor cross-checked via #[test] attribute count: 63 in git HEAD tree == 63 in current working tree (the +2 in the 65 total are macro-generated __semio_plugin_sanity_* tests, present both before and after).

Tree confirmed pure: only 🦀️component.rs / plain folders / 📦️packages remain under the owner root (excluding 🧩️extensions/). Registrar handoff: empty — grep found zero external references to the old 📦️lib.rs/config.rs/terminology.rs paths, and 📋️project.json's namedInputs glob already covers the moved files.
